research_question: Can a locally quantized Qwen3.5-9B improve general semantic realization and embodied-action planning over the locally quantized Qwen2.5-7B deployment candidate while remaining usable on the project's 32 GB personal computer, without treating those gains as evidence of individual-person identity fidelity?

project_hierarchy.interpretation_rule: A system must first preserve generally competent cognition and communication. Surface-style imitation alone is neither a person nor a replicated individual; individual fidelity must be evaluated separately after general competence passes.

limitations: The cases were development screening cases rather than a frozen source-separated holdout.
Qwen3.5 had no person-specific adapter, so identity fidelity was not evaluated.
Automatic contract acceptance did not establish natural Japanese or human likeness.
These observed screening results cannot be reused as V33 formal outcomes.

stage_1_design.causal_boundary: The model family, parameter count, quantized artifact, tokenizer, renderer, and parser differ together. This is a practical deployment comparison, not a single-variable causal ablation of parameter count.

source_separation: No exact input may occur in V21, V29, prior human-blind sheets, V30, V31, V32 calibration data, or the informal screening cases.
Case identifiers, user inputs, semantic contracts, forbidden content, expected action calls, and no-action labels are committed before formal inference.
The holdout commit must precede the runner-result commit.

rightbrain_generation.post_generation_policy: Raw output is scored first. Existing deterministic sanitization is reported separately and cannot erase a raw failure.

action_generation.execution: No tool is executed. Only parsed calls are scored against the frozen action contract.

controlled_variables: payload leaves, context window, output limits, seeds, and sampling values
memory state, mood, trust, and maximum reply characters
one loaded model at a time and identical warm-up policy

statistics.rightbrain_uncertainty: case-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence interval retaining all seeds and candidates for each resampled case

stage_1_advance_gate.training_authorized: Only a separately preregistered Qwen3.5 persona-adapter experiment using source-separated training, development, and holdout data.

required_conditions: the same Qwen3.5-9B base with the new persona adapter
current Qwen2.5-7B plus V10 as an operational reference, not a matched causal control
stage_2_identity_policy.human_review_rule: Automatic gates must pass before requesting a small source-blind human comparison. General naturalness and target-person fidelity must be scored as separate questions.

architecture_boundary.speech_path: cognitive planner -> speech plan -> persona surface formulator -> text and TTS
architecture_boundary.action_path: cognitive planner -> structured action plan -> allowlisted validator -> VRM bridge
architecture_boundary.prohibited_shortcut: The persona surface formulator must not directly execute unrestricted functions or infer hidden memory merely to sound more like the target person.
architecture_boundary.shared_model_option: A future deployment may share one quantized base model and switch logical role prompts or adapters sequentially, but speech and action evidence must remain separately observable and ablatable.

research_boundary: Passing Stage 1 would show that Qwen3.5-9B is a stronger local candidate for general realization and action-contract tasks under this deployment comparison. It would not show that the system is a person, that it replicates a particular individual, or that Qwen3.5 should replace the production runtime.
